history.title: Your name in groups, settings that stick
changes: New: Set the name your groups see in Goals → Name. If you never set one, your username is used instead of “Friend”.
Fixed: With BiteWise on two devices, a setting changed on one could be quietly undone by the other saving an older copy. Each setting now keeps its newest change.
Fixed: The one-time “steps no longer add calories” switch-off waits for the cloud copy first, so it can’t roll back settings from another device.

history.title: Notes vanish on Coach too
changes: Fixed: On the Coach page a note slid down but stayed visible above the message box. Notes now fade out completely everywhere.

history.title: No more popups
changes: Changed: Level-ups, new badges and finished challenges show as a short note with confetti that goes away by itself (tap it to dismiss sooner). No more “Nice!” popup to close.
Fixed: If a popup was open when BiteWise checked for an update, it gave up on that update for good and the “Update ready” bar stuck around. It now retries until it can update.

history.title: Quieter updates
changes: Changed: After an update, BiteWise shows a short note for a couple of seconds instead of a What’s new popup you had to dismiss. The full list is still in Me → Version.
Changed: The “Update ready” bar at the top goes away by itself after a couple of seconds (updates install on the next open anyway).
Changed: Tap any note to dismiss it right away. The update bar has an × too.

history.title: Groups update live
changes: New: While BiteWise is open, groups now update within a few seconds of anyone logging food, weighing in, or changing their numbers — no reopening needed. Open group and member pages update in place too.
New: Pull down on Today or Progress to refresh, or tap the round refresh button on a group card.

history.title: Calories left in groups
changes: New: Groups show how many calories each person has left today (or how far over), on Today, Progress, the group page and a member’s page.
Changed: Streaks are gone from groups. People are listed you first, then by name.
Changed: Steps no longer add calories to your daily budget. It’s off for everyone; Me → Steps earn calories turns it back on if you want it.

Fixed: On a phone where BiteWise has no log yet (like a freshly installed home-screen app), the welcome page buried its buttons under the tour. Get started and “I already use BiteWise · sign in” now sit right under the headline, and sign-in by code needs no password.
Fixed: Group lines on phones wrap instead of cutting off at “6,200 st…”, and group card headers no longer squash the title.

history.title: Pounds lost really follows your weigh-ins
changes: Fixed: Saving Goals quietly locked in your first weigh-in as the starting weight, so deleting that old weigh-in didn’t change pounds lost. The starting weight now only counts when you actually set it.
New: The weigh-ins page says exactly where pounds lost is counted from, and lets you change the starting weight or go back to counting from your first weigh-in.
Changed: Progress says which weight pounds lost is counted from.

history.title: Stays signed in, pick your starting weight
changes: New: Goals has a starting weight. Pounds lost counts from it, so changing “weight now” can’t make it say you gained. Tap “Start over from today’s weight” to reset it.
New: Edit or delete any past weigh-in, or add one for an earlier day — Progress → Weight → All, or Goals → Past weigh-ins.

Fixed: Phones clearing site data signed people out and dropped their groups. BiteWise now keeps a second sign-in on the server and signs itself back in. If it can’t, a banner signs you back in with one tap and your groups come straight back.
Fixed: A database hiccup used to look like “signed out” and the app dropped the login. It now waits and tries again.
New: Adding BiteWise to your home screen opens it already signed in, with the same log and groups as Safari.
New: Me → Use on another device shows a 6-letter code that signs in an iPad, Mac or new phone — no password needed, works for automatic accounts too.
Changed: Sign out is available for every account.

history.title: Look back on anyone’s days
changes: New: On a group member’s page, use the arrows or tap a day in the week bars to see what they ate that day, their calories against their goal, steps, and their weigh-in if they had one. Goes back two weeks.
New: Log food for someone on the day you’re looking at, not just today.

history.title: Honest weight numbers
changes: Fixed: Pounds lost was taken from a smoothed trend line, so 180 then 179 showed as “down 0.2”. It’s now simply your first weigh-in minus your latest. Same for the weight shown everywhere.
Fixed: In groups, weight and pounds lost are worked out on the server from the real weigh-ins, so they can’t go stale.
Fixed: If a member’s log can’t be read, old pushed numbers are dropped instead of shown, so yesterday’s calories can’t appear as today’s.
Fixed: Group numbers saved from an earlier day are blanked while the fresh ones load.
Fixed: If the app stays open past midnight, Today moves to the new day and groups refresh on their own.
Fixed: Logging a weight like 176.4 kept the decimals on the Goals screen.
Fixed: “This week” weight change on a member’s page compared against the wrong weigh-in.

history.title: Groups stay current
changes: Fixed: Group members showed yesterday’s calories (“ghost calories”) after midnight. Today’s calories, progress and steps are now worked out from their actual log on the server, so they reset at midnight and update as soon as their food syncs.
Fixed: Groups only loaded once when the app opened. They now refresh when you come back to the app, every 45 seconds while it’s open, right after you log, and after you log for someone else.
Fixed: Today didn’t redraw when group data arrived, so the group cards could sit on old numbers until you switched tabs.

history.title: Groups at a glance
changes: New: Your groups show up on Today with everyone’s calories, progress bar, pounds lost, weight and streak. No tapping needed. Same on Progress.
New: Log weight button right in the group card and group screen.
New: Me → Sharing → “Show my exact weight”. Turn it off and your groups see how much you’ve lost, like “down 3 lb”, never the number.
New: Pounds lost shows for everyone who’s sharing, in the group list and on their page.
Changed: Me → Groups row shows a quick line of how your people are doing today.

history.title: Goals you just type
changes: Changed: Goals is now three numbers: weight now, goal weight, calories a day. Type them and save. No formula unless you tap “Work out a number for me”.
Fixed: The goal weight field used to disappear once you set your own calorie number, so it couldn’t be changed. It’s always there now.
Fixed: Telling Bitey “set my goal to 150” now sets your goal weight. Before, there was no such action, so nothing changed (or offline Bitey treated 150 as calories).
Changed: Telling Bitey your weight also updates the weight on your Goals screen.
New: Right after you make or join a group, BiteWise asks if you want to share with it. One tap.

history.title: Quick adds and simple sharing
changes: New: Quick adds. Make your own one-tap buttons for Today with a name, the calories and a color. They replace the guessed “usual” chips, so nothing shows up that you didn’t set yourself.
Changed: Sharing is one switch (Me → Sharing). It’s off until you turn it on. On, everyone in your groups sees your goal, streak, steps, weight and the food you log, and can log food for you.
New: Tap someone in a group to see their weight, this week, and what they ate today, with a Log for them button right there.
Changed: The sharing switch is saved with your profile, so it’s the same on every device you sign in on.
Changed: Logging food for a friend only works once they’ve turned sharing on.

history.title: Fresh starts and your own goal
changes: New: A new welcome screen with more about what BiteWise does, how it works, and what's free.
New: During setup, see exactly how your goal was worked out, and set your own number right there.
Changed: The lowest goal is 1,200 calories for everyone.
New: Sample data shows a banner and a Start fresh button. It's never saved to an account, and making an account clears it.
New: Delete my account (Me). It removes your cloud backup and takes you out of your groups.
Fixed: Delete all data now also clears your cloud backup, so old data can't come back after you sign in.

history.title: Updates that actually update
changes: Fixed: Refreshing could keep an old version when the connection was slow. New versions now install themselves when you open the app.
Fixed: The Update button fully refreshes the app's saved copy. Your data isn't touched.
Fixed: One slow file (like the food database) can no longer block an update.

history.title: Controls stay in reach
changes: Changed: A bolder BiteWise logo with a clearer bite and a leaf, in your theme's colors.
Fixed: On Bitey, the Bitey / Recipes switch and Clear stay at the top while you scroll or type. The big title shrinks out of the way.
Fixed: Recipes search, Progress Week / Month, and the log sheet's tabs and search box stay pinned while you scroll.
Fixed: Pop-up messages no longer block taps on the tab bar, and they don't squeeze into three lines.
New: Save button at the top of the goal screen.

history.title: New look, number pad and saved meals
changes: New: A new BiteWise logo that takes on your theme's colors, including the browser tab icon.
New: Themes look better, with a live preview, a soft tint of your color in the background, and gradient buttons.
New: On phones, the calorie box opens BiteWise's own number pad, so the keyboard never covers anything. ABC switches to the regular keyboard.
New: Voice typing. A mic in Bitey's message box and in Type.
New: Saved meals. Save foods you eat together and log them in one tap. Plus 'Same as yesterday'.
Fixed: The message box and pop-ups stay above the phone keyboard.
Fixed: Bitey says hi back, gives estimates when a place doesn't post calories, and no longer shows 'The string did not match the expected pattern'. There's a Try again button.

history.title: Daily pace
changes: New: Daily pace. Set how many calories you usually eat by certain times (Me → Daily pace), or pick Normal day, Big breakfast, Big dinner or Eating window.
New: Today shows a marker for where you'd usually be by now, and says if you're on pace, ahead or under.
New: Bitey knows your usual pace when it gives advice.

history.title: Smarter Bitey, offline Bitey, logging for friends
changes: New: Bitey can look things up, like 'what is Holtman's Donuts', using Wikipedia, DuckDuckGo and OpenStreetMap. Lookups are safe, food and fitness only, and show their sources.
New: Bitey answers with cards: meal ideas with photos, ingredients, calories that add up, steps and a Log this button. Places come with an address, hours, Maps and Website.
New: Offline Bitey. With no internet it still logs food, steps, water, weight and goals, and looks up calories. Other questions are answered automatically when you're back online.
New: People in your group can log food for you (you can turn this off in What I share). It shows who added it, and it arrives even if you were offline.
New: Anything you do offline that needs the internet is saved and sent when you reconnect.
New: 12 free colors, plus Light, Dark or Automatic appearance (Me → Look).

history.title: Bitey can do more
changes: New: Tell Bitey your steps. 'I walked 6,000 steps' sets them, and 'I walked 2,000 more' adds them.
New: Ask Bitey to change your daily goal, like 'make my goal 1,800'. The safety minimum still applies.
New: Ask Bitey to remove something you logged, like 'take off the chips'.
New: Log for yesterday, like 'I forgot to log a burrito yesterday'.
Changed: Everything Bitey changes shows in a card with an Undo button.

history.title: No more 503 on reload
changes: Fixed: Reloading during an update or server restart no longer shows a 503 error. The app uses its saved copy instead.
Changed: BiteWise now runs two copies on the server and updates without downtime.

history.title: New This week card
changes: Changed: 'This week' shows a ring for each day plus your average, days on track, streak and weight trend, instead of tall bars that stretched on big screens.

history.title: Bitey stays on topic
changes: Fixed: Bitey sticks to food, fitness and BiteWise. For other things, like chess or homework, it politely steers back.
Fixed: Web links in Bitey's replies can be tapped.

history.title: A fuller Today page
changes: New: Today is laid out as a grid of cards that fills the screen on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
New: Calories card shows how much you ate at breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks. Tap one to add to it.
New: 'Fits your day' suggests three foods that fit what you have left. One tap logs it, and it skips your allergies.
New: Search button next to the calorie box.
New: Steps card shows your last 7 days on iPad and Mac, plus calories earned from steps.

history.title: Same goal rules for everyone
changes: Changed: No separate under-18 rules. Everyone can pick any pace up to about 1% of body weight a week, or set their own number.
Changed: The lowest goal is 1,200 calories (1,500 for male) for everyone.

history.title: Setting your own number
changes: Fixed: 'Set my own number' no longer quietly ignores numbers below your minimum. It tells you the lowest you can set and why.
Fixed: Me and Today always show the goal that's actually being used.
Changed: The − button stops at your minimum.

history.title: Groups, 5,000+ foods and allergies
changes: New: Groups. Make a group, send the 6-letter code, and see each other's goals, streaks and progress. You choose what you share.
New: 5,431 foods from the USDA database, with real serving sizes. They work offline.
New: Search brand-name foods online (Open Food Facts).
New: Recipes with ingredients, steps and YouTube videos.
New: Allergies. Set yours in Me and BiteWise warns you when a food has them. Bitey won't suggest them either.
New: Food suggestions while you type on the home screen.
New: A 'This week' card on the home screen.
New: Version number, update check, and this What's new screen.
Fixed: The coach message box now clears after you send.

history.title: Easy goals and your account everywhere
changes: New: Goal screen with Lose / Maintain / Gain, how fast, or set your own calorie number.
New: 'I already have an account' on the first screen, and a 'Save your progress' step.
New: Stay signed in until you choose Sign out.
Fixed: Signing in on a new device no longer overwrites your cloud goals.
Fixed: Page margins after signing in on a second device.

history.title: Smoother logging
changes: New: Log sheet with one row of modes, four meal tiles and a thumb-height keypad.
New: Type numbers with a Mac or iPad keyboard.
New: Bigger edit screen, meal icons, and foods slide in and fold away.
Fixed: Pop-up messages no longer cover buttons.

history.title: Calmer home screen
changes: New: Home shows just calories eaten and steps, with quick log right there.
New: Screens update smoothly instead of redrawing.
New: Fitbit sync through Google Health.
Changed: 'Sex' is now 'Gender' with an Other option.

history.title: First release
changes: Quick log, voice and text logging that work offline.
Bitey, the AI coach, on Cloud Foundry open models.
Health Score, levels, badges, streaks and themes.
Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac, and installs to the home screen.
